name: fix-pos-table-merge-feedback
title: Fix false POS table merge errors and missing split refresh
description: Wire the POS table refresh callback correctly so merge/split update immediately and successful merges do not fall into the failure alert.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Root cause confirmed from the actual POS caller: PosContext exposes refetchTables, but LeftPanel destructures refreshTables. The undefined callback throws after a successful drag-drop merge and is passed as undefined to TableActionsModal, so both merge and split require manual refresh.
